title: Delete unused features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart — dead code, duplicate class name, hardcoded English
rule: AG-4 (duplicate top-level symbol names) / AG-6 (dead code)
why: grep -rln "PaceIndicator(" lib/ and grep -rln "features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart" lib/ both return zero hits outside the file's own definition — this PaceIndicator/ProjectedCompletionText pair is never built into any screen (curriculum_progress_screen.dart uses the DIFFERENT features/progress PaceIndicator instead). 91 lines of widget tests exist purely to exercise unreachable code, and the duplicate class name across two features is exactly the AG-4 hazard the standards name: a future agent asked to fix 'the pace indicator' can edit this file, believe the fix shipped, and see nothing change because it never renders.
recommendation: Delete lib/features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart and test/features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator_test.dart. If the scheduler screen is meant to show a pace indicator, wire this widget into scheduler_screen.dart and route its strings through the existing paceAhead/paceBehind/paceOnPace ARB keys (already used by features/progress's PaceIndicator), and rename to avoid the AG-4 clash.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rl "features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart" lib/ test/ returns nothing (removed) or exactly one real screen caller (wired).
grep -rn "^class PaceIndicator" lib/ returns exactly one match repo-wide.
mergedFrom: Rename one of the two unrelated PaceIndicator classes (progress vs scheduler features)
